name: Jamie Donnelly
source: Jamie is the classmate who is dedicated to making a difference in the community. He attracted the school's admission counselors with his novel ideas and was invited to attend the academy on a scholarship. He sometimes butts heads with Leo because of his different perspective and background from growing up on a farm in the countryside.
